name: Tagokoro Madoka
source:
She is in her second marriage and Haruki's step-mother. At first glance, she appears to be a gentle and mischievous mother, but her voluptuous body and the scent that emanates from her extraordinary breasts tempts men.

She has taken countless men captive, and the reason she left her ex-husband was because of her demands for constant sex until he became impotent.

Despite the fact that she has a new husband, she is also trying to get with her step-son Haruki, and the reason for this is because she gets off on breaking the rules of morality. By the way, she has no malicious intent to bring misfortune to others.
